metadata.description: Live-captured via bin/mock-capture against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org group 138883 (sdktest), the recapture epic's Workstream C. Resolves InternalAppsV2Service.GetApplicationList (operation InternalAppsV2_GetApplicationList) using the real AppProvisioningProfileUuid attached to internal iOS app id 66115 (created via tools/internalapps-capture with a valid, unexpired embedded.mobileprovision -- see the sibling begininstall fixture's description for the DTPlatformName precondition). Previously blocked (see this endpoint's now-superseded unverified ledger entry): 'mock-capture discovers application UUID from apps/search; this route requires provisioning profile UUID. First discovered internal app had no provisioning profile' -- resolved by reading AppProvisioningProfileUuid off the GET /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId} response for the freshly-created app instead of discovering via apps/search. GENUINE SDK MODEL/WIRE MISMATCH FOUND (not fixed here, out of scope for a capture task -- flagging for a follow-up): internal/mam/v2/models.go's AppListUsingProvisioningProfileModelV2.AppUUIDs is typed []ApplicationUuidV2 (an array of {"appUuids": string} objects), but the live wire response returns "AppUuids" as a plain array of UUID strings (confirmed live, this exact capture) -- json.Unmarshal will fail per-element (a JSON string cannot decode into the ApplicationUuidV2 struct). This fixture preserves the true wire shape (plain string array) rather than the model's declared shape. 200, real success.
